nodes.description: Public mapping address => uint256 tracking token balances; written in constructor, transfer and transferFrom.
Public uint256 total supply minted to the deployer in the constructor.
Public nested mapping owner => spender => uint256 allowance; written by approve and decremented in transferFrom.
Constructor/initializer that assigns the whole totalSupply to msg.sender and emits Transfer.
Public transfer function that requires sufficient sender balance and moves tokens via unchecked +=/-=.
Public approve function that sets allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value and emits Approval.
Public transferFrom function that requires balance and allowance, then moves tokens and decrements allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as owner key for balances, approvals and allowance spending.
Unchecked subtraction on the sender balance inside transfer.
Unchecked addition on the recipient balance inside transfer.
Unchecked subtraction on the source balance inside transferFrom.
Unchecked subtraction of the spender allowance inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transfer and transferFrom.

edges.reason: Constructor writes the balanceOf mapping for the deployer.
Constructor reads totalSupply to mint the initial balance.
msg.sender is used as the recipient key when the constructor sets balanceOf.
transfer executes the sender balance deduction.
transfer executes the recipient balance addition.
transfer consumes the to parameter.
transfer consumes the value parameter.
balanceOf state is read before being decremented in transfer.
msg.sender indexes balanceOf in the transfer deduction.
User-supplied value is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without overflow protection.
balanceOf state is read and written for the recipient in transfer.
to parameter indexes balanceOf in the transfer addition.
User-supplied value is added to balanceOf[to] without overflow protection.
approve writes to the allowance mapping.
approve consumes the spender parameter.
msg.sender is the owner key when approve sets allowance.
spender parameter is the spender key when approve sets allowance.
transferFrom executes the source balance deduction.
transferFrom executes the allowance deduction.
transferFrom consumes the from parameter.
balanceOf[from] is read in the transferFrom require check.
from parameter indexes balanceOf in the transferFrom deduction.
User-supplied value is subtracted from balanceOf[from] without overflow protection.
allowance[from][msg.sender] is consulted as the authorization gate of transferFrom.
allowance state is read and then decremented, coupling authorization to the unsafe subtraction.
msg.sender acts as the spender whose allowance write is authorized only by the require check.
from parameter indexes the allowance mapping in the transferFrom deduction.
User-supplied value is subtracted from allowance[from][msg.sender] without overflow protection.

normalization_plan.reason: to is only used as the recipient key inside transfer; it can be normalized into the transfer function node.
value is the amount consumed by the unchecked balance subtraction, so it folds into that unsafe operation.
spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve; normalize into the approve function node.
from is only used as the source key inside transferFrom; normalize into the transferFrom function node.
